text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

—Tokyo Racecourse was trembling.
At the promised victory of that Umamusume.
Everyone now acknowledged it. The strength of this Umamusume... that she was Japan's strongest.

It wasn't just the spectators. Many people
were "convinced" by the outcome of that race—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! As expected of Duramente, huh.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Soooo strong!
—As expected, of course!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
...Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Time for me to go train, too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your racing is truly...
as brilliant as magic.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Duramente.
I wonder if your next miracle... will be shown to us in France?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid!
Duramente, brilliant performance!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's send her a letter of congratulations right away!
Tazuna! My brush!

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Dura.
You've leaped beyond your lineage and carried everything upon your shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad that you
were my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You did it, Dura.
(Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
From Mother...
Heh, she seems remarkably delighted.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Can you feel it, Dura?
Countless hopes and feelings are reaching out to you—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Duramente! Duramente!
Duramente! Duramente!
Duramente! Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...It's burning hot.
And besides—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...After saying all that, I was completely useless... Um—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, Cheval.
Fists out, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Place your hands on my chest.
—I want your feelings too."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Taking everything with me,
I will go take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A Japanese Umamusume will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
And... I'm taking you all with me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Guh~, Dura-san!
That's quite a slick move!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll entrust them to you!
All of our feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this,
Cheval-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, count me in too!
I'm quite good at percussion, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Earth-san!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Come at me with everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, huh...—
Ah, whatever! Here goes!
(THUD...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!!
I-I-I'm so sorry...!!

After the race,
while waiting for Duramente at the entrance...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Having about this much weight feels just right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Have I become the strongest in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case,
there is only one path to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "As an Umamusume worthy of carrying this nation on her shoulders and conquering the world... I will reach those heights next year."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Here" is the beginning.
From here, I will challenge it—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Next up is the "World's Strongest".
